# Virtual Scrum Team worker sandbox specification

Status: implementation contract for S2. A sandbox is not accepted until the
operator provisioned it and the signed, run-bound pre-flight inventory passes.
The repository code does not provision or weaken the host boundary.

## Isolation boundary

Use a dedicated WSL distribution or a dedicated virtual machine for each
trusted execution environment. In WSL, disable Windows drive automount and
Windows/Linux interoperability in `/etc/wsl.conf`; restart the distribution
after changing either setting. The worker must not see `/mnt/c`, other Windows
drive mounts, host home directories, host credential stores, Docker/Podman or
container-engine sockets, or any host path outside the per-run workspace.
Prefer a VM when the WSL host cannot enforce these conditions.

Run the worker as a non-root, unprivileged account distinct from the runner,
signer, supervisor, and reviewer accounts. The worker account receives only
the run directory and per-run scoped credentials needed for the task. Those
credentials are created for one run and removed during cleanup. They must
never include receipt-signing keys or signer credentials. The signing key is
owned by the signer identity and mode 0600. The Unix signer socket lives in a
signer-owned directory that grants traversal only to the runner group (mode
0710); the socket is group-owned by the runner group and mode 0660. The worker
account is not a member of the runner group and the runner drops supplementary
groups when launching it. The signer authenticates runner UID using kernel
peer credentials and rejects all other identities.

Review runs under a separate read-only identity. Its credential must have no
write access to the worker worktree or control-plane store. The runner verifies
that the mounted review tree is read-only before launching review. A failure
to prove the effective OS permissions blocks the review.

## Network policy

Egress is default-deny at the sandbox network boundary. The external egress
allowlist is empty by default; adding an endpoint requires a separately
recorded task-specific policy. DNS and indirect routes are also denied unless
explicitly allowed. The local pre-flight loopback canary binds an ephemeral
127.0.0.1 port inside the sandbox and is not a public-network exception. An
operator-root-signed, run/spec/nonce-bound network-policy attestation identifies
the environment, SHA-256 digests of the enforced policy and private evidence,
an empty external allowlist, no container socket, and no unapproved host paths.
The supervisor verifies this attestation independently. A connection attempt
to one reserved documentation address is only a limited smoke probe; failure
does not prove default-deny egress and success fails pre-flight.

## Resource and filesystem limits

Each run has an operator-configured CPU quota, memory ceiling, process count
limit, disk quota, and wall-clock deadline. The values are recorded in the
run configuration before launch; absence of any limit blocks the worker.
Commands use the run directory as their working directory, a minimal
allowlisted environment, no inherited stdin, bounded output capture, and
process-tree termination. No host path beyond that run directory may be
mounted or passed to the worker. Job Object nesting on Windows must be
verified on the target host; unsupported nesting is a refusal, not a
best-effort success.

## Required pre-flight evidence

Before each worker run, the standard-library-only probe records the mount
table and an explicit `windows_drive_mounts` list. It classifies a mount as a
Windows drive only when the mount source is a drive root (`C:` or `C:\\`) and
the filesystem is `drvfs` directly or WSL's `9p` with `aname=drvfs`; unrelated
mount targets such as `/mnt/wslg` do not count as Windows-drive automount. It
also records Windows interop state,
user and group identity, container socket paths,
blocked-target smoke-probe result, sandbox-local loopback result, and
environment variable names. It binds the inventory to the run ID, a fresh
nonce, and this file's SHA-256 digest. The operator separately signs the
network-policy attestation with a distinct
operator-only key. The probe inventory itself is not cryptographically signed.
The root Supervisor accepts it only from its root-owned mode-0600 preflight file,
checks the exact run/spec/nonce and all required measurements, and independently
verifies the operator-signed network-policy attestation. The root-controlled
systemd unit and the root capture of its exact invocation are the provenance
boundary for the inventory. The operator key is never copied to the runner,
worker, or analyzer. All six receipt and policy trust roots (worker, supervisor,
operator, event, reviewer, runner-signer) remain pairwise distinct. Socket discovery spans known engine
endpoints, numeric per-user runtime directories, and `/proc/net/unix`; inability
to enumerate a required source fails closed.
The supervisor may start a worker only when the root-captured inventory is
fresh and bound to the same run and spec digest, every check passes, and the
operator-signed network-policy attestation verifies.
An enabled automount or interop setting, present container socket, root UID,
reachable external target, failed loopback canary, missing inventory field,
or stale run binding blocks launch.

The probe can observe configured conditions; it does not prove that a host
firewall or hypervisor is correctly configured. Provisioning and enforcement
of the OS/network/resource boundary are operator-verified acceptance items.
Record the exact distribution/VM identity and policy evidence with the run.

## External event anchor coordination

The external event anchor and its `.coord.lock` sidecar must both be outside
the worker mount. Every store process that can write events or make an
authoritative gate decision must use the same coordinator lock path. The lock
is held across the SQLite write transaction and all external checkpoint
appends; an authoritative read holds it from before opening the database
snapshot through comparison with the external anchor. This prevents a reader
from interpreting a concurrent valid checkpoint advance as tampering and
prevents concurrent store writers from appending out of order.

After a crash, startup may advance the external anchor across more than one
event only when the full database event HMAC chain verifies and the latest
external checkpoint exactly matches the event at its recorded count. The
store then compare-and-appends each missing checkpoint in order before
permitting a lease or gate decision. It never creates a missing anchor for a
non-empty database, never accepts an anchor ahead of the database, and never
repairs a fork, malformed event chain, invalid checkpoint, or mismatching
prefix. Any such condition stays write-locked for operator recovery.

#!/bin/sh
set -eu

usage() {
    echo "usage: install_wsl_runner_runtime.sh EXPECTED_HEAD SOURCE_BUNDLE_ROOT ARCHIVE_SHA256 PLAN_SHA256 INVENTORY_SHA256 [--stage-only]" >&2
    exit 2
}

[ "$#" -eq 5 ] || [ "$#" -eq 6 ] || usage
expected_head=$1
bundle_root=$2
archive_sha=$3
plan_sha=$4
inventory_sha=$5
stage_only=0
if [ "$#" -eq 6 ]; then
    [ "$6" = "--stage-only" ] || usage
    stage_only=1
fi
case "$expected_head" in
    *[!0-9a-f]*|'') echo "expected head must be a full lowercase commit id" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
[ "${#expected_head}" -eq 40 ] || { echo "expected head must be 40 hex characters" >&2; exit 1; }
case "$archive_sha" in
    *[!0-9a-f]*|'') echo "archive digest must be a lowercase SHA-256" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
[ "${#archive_sha}" -eq 64 ] || { echo "archive digest must be 64 hex characters" >&2; exit 1; }
case "$plan_sha" in
    *[!0-9a-f]*|'') echo "source plan digest must be a lowercase SHA-256" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
[ "${#plan_sha}" -eq 64 ] || { echo "source plan digest must be 64 hex characters" >&2; exit 1; }
case "$inventory_sha" in
    *[!0-9a-f]*|'') echo "target inventory digest must be a lowercase SHA-256" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
[ "${#inventory_sha}" -eq 64 ] || { echo "target inventory digest must be 64 hex characters" >&2; exit 1; }
[ "$(/usr/bin/id -u)" -eq 0 ] || { echo "installer must run as root" >&2; exit 1; }

bundle_root=$(/usr/bin/realpath -e -- "$bundle_root")
/usr/bin/python3.12 -I -S -c 'import os,re,sys; head,path=sys.argv[1:]; assert re.fullmatch(r"/run/vst-deploy-"+head+r"-[0-9a-f]{32}", path)' "$expected_head" "$bundle_root" || {
    echo "source bundle must use a unique fixed distro-local deployment path" >&2; exit 1;
}
[ "$(/usr/bin/stat -c '%u:%a' "$bundle_root")" = "0:700" ] || {
    echo "source bundle must be a root-owned mode-0700 directory" >&2; exit 1;
}
/usr/bin/python3.12 -I -S "$bundle_root/tools/qa/verify_wsl_source_bundle.py" \
    --root "$bundle_root" --expected-head "$expected_head" \
    --archive-sha256 "$archive_sha" --plan-sha256 "$plan_sha" \
    --inventory-sha256 "$inventory_sha"

. /etc/os-release
[ "${ID:-}" = ubuntu ] && [ "${VERSION_ID:-}" = 24.04 ] || {
    echo "installer requires Ubuntu 24.04" >&2; exit 1;
}
/bin/grep -qi microsoft /proc/sys/kernel/osrelease || {
    echo "installer requires WSL" >&2; exit 1;
}
/usr/bin/python3.12 -I -S -c 'import configparser; p=configparser.ConfigParser(); p.read("/etc/wsl.conf"); assert p.getboolean("automount", "enabled") is False; assert p.getboolean("interop", "enabled") is False; assert p.getboolean("interop", "appendWindowsPath") is False' || {
    echo "WSL automount and interop must both be disabled" >&2; exit 1;
}
/usr/bin/python3.12 -I -S - <<'PY'
import re
with open("/proc/self/mountinfo", encoding="ascii") as stream:
    for line in stream:
        fields = line.rstrip("\n").split(" - ", 1)
        if len(fields) != 2:
            raise SystemExit("cannot parse complete mount inventory")
        mount = fields[1].split()
        if len(mount) < 3:
            raise SystemExit("cannot parse mount entry")
        fs_type, source, super_options = mount[:3]
        drive_source = bool(re.match(r"^[A-Za-z]:[\\/]?$", source))
        if fs_type == "drvfs" or (fs_type == "9p" and (drive_source or "aname=drvfs" in super_options)):
            raise SystemExit("Windows-drive mount is visible; refusing runtime install")
PY

if [ "$stage_only" -eq 1 ]; then
    /usr/bin/python3.12 -I -B -S - "$bundle_root" <<'PY'
import os, subprocess, sys

sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])
from tools.vst.runtime_bundle import validate_root_config_directory

for path in ("/run/vst-supervisor", "/run/vst-runner"):
    if os.path.lexists(path):
        raise SystemExit("stage-only requires absent runtime socket paths: " + path)
validate_root_config_directory("/etc/vst-runner")

units = (
    "vst-supervisor.service", "vst-signer.service", "vst-runner.service",
    "vst-dispatcher.service", "vst-dispatch-owner.service", "vst-dispatch-owner.socket",
)
for unit in units:
    load_state = subprocess.run(
        ["/usr/bin/systemctl", "show", "--property=LoadState", "--value", unit],
        stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        check=False, text=True,
    )
    active_state = subprocess.run(
        ["/usr/bin/systemctl", "show", "--property=ActiveState", "--value", unit],
        stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        check=False, text=True,
    )
    if (load_state.returncode == 0 and load_state.stdout.strip() == "not-found"
            and active_state.returncode in (0, 1)
            and active_state.stdout.strip() in ("", "inactive")):
        continue
    if (load_state.returncode != 0 or load_state.stdout.strip() != "loaded"
            or active_state.returncode != 0 or active_state.stdout.strip() != "inactive"):
        raise SystemExit("stage-only requires each S2 unit to be loaded-inactive or not-found: " + unit)

jobs = subprocess.run(
    ["/usr/bin/systemctl", "list-jobs", "--no-legend", "--plain"],
    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
    check=False, text=True,
)
if jobs.returncode != 0:
    raise SystemExit("cannot establish systemd job inventory")
affected = set(units)
for line in jobs.stdout.splitlines():
    fields = line.split()
    if len(fields) < 4 or not fields[0].isdigit():
        raise SystemExit("cannot parse complete systemd job inventory")
    if fields[1] in affected:
        raise SystemExit("stage-only requires no systemd job for S2 unit: " + fields[1])

for unit in units:
    control_group = subprocess.run(
        ["/usr/bin/systemctl", "show", "--property=ControlGroup", "--value", unit],
        stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        check=False, text=True,
    )
    if control_group.returncode == 1 and not control_group.stdout.strip():
        continue
    if control_group.returncode != 0:
        raise SystemExit("cannot establish S2 unit cgroup: " + unit)
    relative = control_group.stdout.strip().lstrip("/")
    if not relative:
        continue
    cgroup = os.path.join("/sys/fs/cgroup", relative)
    if not os.path.isdir(cgroup):
        raise SystemExit("cannot inspect S2 unit cgroup: " + unit)
    for current, directories, _files in os.walk(cgroup, followlinks=False):
        if os.path.islink(current):
            raise SystemExit("S2 cgroup inventory contains a symlink")
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(current, "cgroup.events"), encoding="ascii") as stream:
                events = dict(line.split() for line in stream if line.strip())
        except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise SystemExit("cannot read S2 cgroup population state: " + unit) from exc
        if events.get("populated") != "0":
            raise SystemExit("stage-only requires empty S2 service cgroups: " + unit)
        for directory in directories:
            if os.path.islink(os.path.join(current, directory)):
                raise SystemExit("S2 cgroup inventory contains a symlink")
PY
fi

runtime_link=/opt/vst-runtime
unit_dir=/etc/systemd/system

stage=$(/usr/bin/mktemp -d /opt/.vst-runtime-stage.XXXXXX)
unit_tmp=
trap '[ -z "$unit_tmp" ] || /bin/rm -f -- "$unit_tmp"; /bin/rm -rf -- "$stage"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
/usr/bin/install -d -o root -g root -m 0755 "$stage/tools"
/usr/bin/cp -a -- "$bundle_root/tools/vst" "$stage/tools/vst"
[ -f "$bundle_root/docs/SANDBOX_SPEC.md" ] || {
    echo "source bundle is missing the S2 sandbox specification" >&2; exit 1;
}
/usr/bin/cp -a -- "$bundle_root/docs" "$stage/docs"
[ -f "$stage/tools/vst/systemd/vst-supervisor.service" ] &&
    [ -f "$stage/tools/vst/systemd/vst-signer.service" ] &&
    [ -f "$stage/tools/vst/systemd/vst-runner.service" ] &&
    [ -f "$stage/tools/vst/systemd/vst-dispatcher.service" ] &&
    [ -f "$stage/tools/vst/systemd/vst-dispatch-owner.service" ] &&
    [ -f "$stage/tools/vst/systemd/vst-dispatch-owner.socket" ] || {
    echo "source bundle is missing a required systemd unit" >&2; exit 1;
}
/usr/bin/chown -R root:root "$stage/tools/vst"
/usr/bin/find "$stage/tools/vst" -type d -exec /bin/chmod 0755 {} +
/usr/bin/find "$stage/tools/vst" -type f -exec /bin/chmod 0644 {} +
/usr/bin/chown -R root:root "$stage/docs"
/usr/bin/find "$stage/docs" -type d -exec /bin/chmod 0755 {} +
/usr/bin/find "$stage/docs" -type f -exec /bin/chmod 0644 {} +
/usr/bin/python3.12 -I -S - "$stage/.vst-runtime-manifest.json" "$expected_head" "$archive_sha" "$plan_sha" "$inventory_sha" "$bundle_root" <<'PY'
import json, os, sys
path, head, digest, plan_digest, inventory_digest, bundle_root = sys.argv[1:]
fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o644)
with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="ascii") as stream:
    source_manifest_path = os.path.join(bundle_root, ".vst-source-manifest.json")
    with open(source_manifest_path, "r", encoding="ascii") as source_stream:
        source_manifest = json.load(source_stream)
    json.dump({"archive_sha256": digest,
               "compiler_path": source_manifest["compiler_path"],
               "compiler_resolved_path": source_manifest["compiler_resolved_path"],
               "compiler_sha256": source_manifest["compiler_sha256"],
               "compiler_symlink_target": source_manifest["compiler_symlink_target"],
               "head": head, "inventory_sha256": inventory_digest,
               "plan_sha256": plan_digest, "schema": 3}, stream,
              sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
    stream.flush()
    os.fsync(stream.fileno())

import hashlib, json, os, stat, sys
stage, runtime, link, unit_dir, head, digest, stage_only, plan_sha, inventory_sha, bundle_root = sys.argv[1:]
stage_only = stage_only == "1"
def path_exists(path): return os.path.lexists(path)
def scan(root, installed=False):
    result = {}
    root_info = os.lstat(root)
    if not stat.S_ISDIR(root_info.st_mode):
        raise SystemExit("runtime package root is not a directory: " + root)
    if installed and (root_info.st_uid != 0 or stat.S_IMODE(root_info.st_mode) != 0o755):
        raise SystemExit("installed runtime package root has unexpected owner/mode: " + root)
    for current, dirs, files in os.walk(root, followlinks=False):
        dirs.sort(); files.sort()
        for name in dirs + files:
            path = os.path.join(current, name)
            info = os.lstat(path)
            rel = os.path.relpath(path, root).replace(os.sep, "/")
            if stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode):
                if installed and (info.st_uid != 0 or stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) != 0o755):
                    raise SystemExit("existing runtime directory has unexpected owner/mode: " + path)
                result[rel] = ("dir", None)
            elif stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode):
                if installed and (info.st_uid != 0 or stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) != 0o644 or info.st_nlink != 1):
                    raise SystemExit("existing runtime file has unexpected owner/mode: " + path)
                with open(path, "rb") as stream: digest_value = hashlib.sha256(stream.read()).hexdigest()
                result[rel] = ("file", digest_value)
            else:
                raise SystemExit("runtime path contains an unexpected file type: " + path)
    return result
with open(os.path.join(bundle_root, ".vst-source-manifest.json"), "r", encoding="ascii") as stream:
    source_manifest = json.load(stream)
expected_runtime = {
    name: (entry["kind"], entry.get("sha256"))
    for name, entry in source_manifest["archive_members"].items()
    if name in ("tools", "tools/vst", "docs")
    or name.startswith("tools/vst/") or name.startswith("docs/")
}
if not expected_runtime:
    raise SystemExit("reviewed source manifest has no runtime entries")
staged_tree = scan(stage, installed=True)
if sorted(os.listdir(stage)) != [".vst-runtime-manifest.json", "docs", "tools"]:
    raise SystemExit("staged runtime has unexpected or missing top-level entries")
staged_tree.pop(".vst-runtime-manifest.json", None)
if staged_tree != expected_runtime:
    raise SystemExit("staged runtime tree differs from exact reviewed source manifest")
if path_exists(runtime):
    info = os.lstat(runtime)
    marker = os.path.join(runtime, ".vst-runtime-manifest.json")
    if not stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) or info.st_uid != 0 or stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) != 0o755:
        raise SystemExit("runtime destination is not a root-owned mode-0755 directory")
    if sorted(os.listdir(runtime)) != [".vst-runtime-manifest.json", "docs", "tools"]:
        raise SystemExit("runtime destination has unexpected or missing entries")
    marker_info = os.lstat(marker)
    if not stat.S_ISREG(marker_info.st_mode) or marker_info.st_uid != 0 or stat.S_IMODE(marker_info.st_mode) != 0o644:
        raise SystemExit("runtime destination manifest has unexpected owner, mode, or type")
    with open(marker, "r", encoding="ascii") as stream: manifest = json.load(stream)
    expected_marker = {
        "archive_sha256": digest,
        "compiler_path": source_manifest["compiler_path"],
        "compiler_resolved_path": source_manifest["compiler_resolved_path"],
        "compiler_sha256": source_manifest["compiler_sha256"],
        "compiler_symlink_target": source_manifest["compiler_symlink_target"],
        "head": head, "inventory_sha256": inventory_sha,
        "plan_sha256": plan_sha, "schema": 3,
    }
    if manifest != expected_marker:
        raise SystemExit("runtime destination manifest differs from requested head/digest")
    for subtree in ("tools/vst", "docs"):
        subtree_info = os.lstat(os.path.join(runtime, subtree.split("/", 1)[0]))
        if not stat.S_ISDIR(subtree_info.st_mode) or subtree_info.st_uid != 0 or stat.S_IMODE(subtree_info.st_mode) != 0o755:
            raise SystemExit("runtime top-level directory has unexpected owner/mode")
        if scan(os.path.join(stage, subtree)) != scan(os.path.join(runtime, subtree), installed=True):
            raise SystemExit("runtime destination differs from requested source: " + subtree)
if not stage_only:
    if path_exists(link):
        info = os.lstat(link)
        if not stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode) or info.st_uid != 0 or os.readlink(link) != runtime:
            raise SystemExit("runtime selector exists with different target/type/owner")
    for unit in ("vst-supervisor.service", "vst-signer.service", "vst-runner.service",
                 "vst-dispatcher.service", "vst-dispatch-owner.service", "vst-dispatch-owner.socket"):
        source = os.path.join(stage, "tools/vst/systemd", unit)
        dest = os.path.join(unit_dir, unit)
        if path_exists(dest):
            info = os.lstat(dest)
            if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_uid != 0 or stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) != 0o644:
                raise SystemExit("systemd unit exists with unexpected type/owner/mode: " + dest)
            with open(source, "rb") as a, open(dest, "rb") as b:
                if a.read() != b.read(): raise SystemExit("systemd unit bytes differ: " + dest)
PY
if [ ! -e "$runtime_dir" ] && [ ! -L "$runtime_dir" ]; then
    /usr/bin/mv -Tn -- "$stage" "$runtime_dir"
    [ ! -e "$stage" ] || {
        echo "runtime path changed during no-overwrite install; inspect state before retry" >&2; exit 1;
    }

if [ "$stage_only" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "staged immutable runtime revision $expected_head from the verified source bundle"
    echo "runtime_dir=$runtime_dir"
    echo "selected=false"
    echo "systemd_units_installed=0"
    exit 0

    /bin/ln -s "$runtime_dir" "$runtime_link"

    vst-dispatch-owner.service vst-dispatch-owner.socket; do
    unit_path="$unit_dir/$unit"
    if [ ! -e "$unit_path" ] && [ ! -L "$unit_path" ]; then
        unit_tmp=$(/usr/bin/mktemp "$unit_dir/.vst-unit.XXXXXX")
        /usr/bin/install -o root -g root -m 0644 \
            "$runtime_dir/tools/vst/systemd/$unit" "$unit_tmp"
        /bin/ln -- "$unit_tmp" "$unit_path" || {
            echo "unit destination changed during no-overwrite installation: $unit_path" >&2; exit 1;
        }
        /bin/rm -f -- "$unit_tmp"
        unit_tmp=
    fi
done

echo "installed immutable runtime revision $expected_head from the verified source bundle"
echo "runtime_dir=$runtime_dir"
echo "systemd_units_installed=6 (not enabled or started)"

#!/bin/sh
set -eu

usage() {
    echo "usage: install_wsl_worker_helper.sh EXPECTED_HEAD SOURCE_BUNDLE_ROOT ARCHIVE_SHA256 PLAN_SHA256 INVENTORY_SHA256" >&2
    exit 2
}

[ "$#" -eq 5 ] || usage
expected_head=$1
bundle_root=$2
archive_sha=$3
plan_sha=$4
inventory_sha=$5

[ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ] || { echo "installer must run as root" >&2; exit 1; }
case "$expected_head" in

===== BEGIN tools/qa/verify_wsl_runtime_stage.py sha256=107921d7213184ae94a276c1e6ea8dd6811b3954f1983460b339598c77a5d4c7 bytes=13368 =====
"""Verify a root-owned S2 runtime stage against its reviewed source map."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import stat
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

HEX40 = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{40}$")
HEX64 = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
MANIFEST = ".vst-runtime-manifest.json"
MAX_SOURCE_MANIFEST_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024


def _fail(message: str) -> None:
    raise SystemExit("runtime stage verification failed: " + message)


def _hash_file(path: str, info: os.stat_result) -> tuple[str, int]:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0))
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        if (not stat.S_ISREG(opened.st_mode) or opened.st_nlink != 1
                or opened.st_uid != 0 or opened.st_gid != 0
                or stat.S_IMODE(opened.st_mode) != 0o644
                or (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino) != (info.st_dev, info.st_ino)):
            _fail("staged file changed type or identity while opening")
        digest = hashlib.sha256()
        size = 0
        while True:
            chunk = os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            size += len(chunk)
            digest.update(chunk)
        after = os.fstat(fd)
        if ((after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns,
             after.st_uid, after.st_gid, stat.S_IMODE(after.st_mode))
                != (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size, opened.st_mtime_ns,
                    opened.st_uid, opened.st_gid, stat.S_IMODE(opened.st_mode))):
            _fail("staged file changed while hashing")
        return digest.hexdigest(), size
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def _expected_runtime(members: object) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    if not isinstance(members, dict) or not members:
        _fail("reviewed source member map is absent")
    for name, entry in members.items():
        if (not isinstance(name, str) or not name or name.startswith("/")
                or "\\" in name or any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in name.split("/"))
                or not isinstance(entry, dict)):
            _fail("reviewed source map contains an invalid path or entry")
        if entry == {"kind": "dir"}:
            continue
        if (set(entry) != {"kind", "sha256", "size"} or entry.get("kind") != "file"
                or not isinstance(entry.get("sha256"), str)
                or not HEX64.fullmatch(entry["sha256"])
                or type(entry.get("size")) is not int or entry["size"] < 0):
            _fail("reviewed source map contains an invalid file fingerprint")
    allowed_files = {
        "docs/SANDBOX_SPEC.md", "tools/qa/install_wsl_runner_runtime.sh",
        "tools/qa/install_wsl_worker_helper.sh", "tools/qa/verify_wsl_source_bundle.py",
        "tools/qa/verify_wsl_runtime_stage.py", "tools/qa/worker_exec.c",
    }
    for name, entry in members.items():
        allowed = (name in allowed_files or name.startswith("tools/vst/")
                   or name in {"tools", "tools/vst", "tools/qa", "docs"})
        if not allowed:
            _fail("reviewed source map contains a path outside the runtime allowlist")
        if entry == {"kind": "dir"}:
            if not (name in {"tools", "tools/vst", "tools/qa", "docs"}
                    or name.startswith("tools/vst/")):
                _fail("reviewed source map contains a disallowed directory")
            continue
        if (set(entry) != {"kind", "sha256", "size"} or entry.get("kind") != "file"
                or not isinstance(entry.get("sha256"), str)
                or not HEX64.fullmatch(entry["sha256"])
                or type(entry.get("size")) is not int or entry["size"] < 0):
            _fail("reviewed source map contains an invalid file fingerprint")
    expected = {
        name: entry for name, entry in members.items()
        if name in {"tools", "tools/vst", "docs"}
        or name.startswith("tools/vst/") or name.startswith("docs/")
    }
    if not expected or "tools/vst" not in expected or "docs" not in expected:
        _fail("reviewed source map lacks runtime roots")
    required = {
        "docs/SANDBOX_SPEC.md", "tools/vst/runner.py", "tools/vst/signer.py",
        "tools/vst/store.py", "tools/vst/supervisor.py", "tools/vst/runner_service.py",
        "tools/vst/supervisor_service.py", "tools/vst/execution_grant.py",
        "tools/vst/runner_fence.py", "tools/vst/dispatcher_service.py",
        "tools/vst/dispatch_instruction.py", "tools/vst/dispatch_owner_client.py",
        "tools/vst/dispatch_owner_service.py", "tools/vst/dispatch_owner_latch.py",
        "tools/vst/systemd/vst-supervisor.service", "tools/vst/systemd/vst-signer.service",
        "tools/vst/systemd/vst-runner.service", "tools/vst/systemd/vst-dispatcher.service",
        "tools/vst/systemd/vst-dispatch-owner.service",
        "tools/vst/systemd/vst-dispatch-owner.socket",
    }
    if not required <= expected.keys():
        _fail("reviewed source map lacks a required runtime artifact")
    return expected


def _read_root_json(path: Path, *, mode: int, maximum: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    before = os.lstat(path)
    if (not stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) or before.st_uid != 0 or before.st_gid != 0
            or stat.S_IMODE(before.st_mode) != mode or before.st_nlink != 1
            or before.st_size > maximum):
        _fail("root-owned JSON artifact has invalid metadata")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0))
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        if ((opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino) != (before.st_dev, before.st_ino)
                or not stat.S_ISREG(opened.st_mode) or opened.st_nlink != 1
                or opened.st_uid != 0 or opened.st_gid != 0
                or stat.S_IMODE(opened.st_mode) != mode):
            _fail("root-owned JSON artifact changed while opening")
        chunks = []
        size = 0
        while True:
            chunk = os.read(fd, min(65536, maximum + 1 - size))
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
            size += len(chunk)
            if size > maximum:
                _fail("root-owned JSON artifact exceeds its size bound")
        after = os.fstat(fd)
        if ((after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns,
             after.st_uid, after.st_gid, stat.S_IMODE(after.st_mode))
                != (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size, opened.st_mtime_ns,
                    opened.st_uid, opened.st_gid, stat.S_IMODE(opened.st_mode))
                or size != before.st_size):
            _fail("root-owned JSON artifact changed while reading")
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    def pairs(items: list[tuple[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        result: dict[str, Any] = {}
        for key, value in items:
            if key in result:
                _fail("root-owned JSON artifact has duplicate fields")
            result[key] = value
        return result
    try:
        value = json.loads(b"".join(chunks), object_pairs_hook=pairs,
                           parse_constant=lambda _value: _fail("root-owned JSON has non-finite values"))
    except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        raise SystemExit("runtime stage verification failed: root-owned JSON is invalid") from exc
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        _fail("root-owned JSON artifact must be an object")
    return value


def verify_staged_runtime(stage: Path, source_manifest_path: Path, *,
                          expected_head: str, archive_sha256: str,
                          plan_sha256: str, inventory_sha256: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if (not HEX40.fullmatch(expected_head)
            or not all(HEX64.fullmatch(value) for value in
                       (archive_sha256, plan_sha256, inventory_sha256))):
        _fail("requested source identity is malformed")
    source_manifest = _read_root_json(source_manifest_path, mode=0o600,
                                      maximum=MAX_SOURCE_MANIFEST_BYTES)
    if (set(source_manifest) != {"archive_members", "archive_sha256", "compiler_path",
                                "compiler_resolved_path", "compiler_sha256",
                                "compiler_symlink_target", "head", "inventory_sha256",
                                "plan_sha256", "schema"}
            or source_manifest.get("schema") != 3
            or source_manifest.get("head") != expected_head
            or source_manifest.get("archive_sha256") != archive_sha256
            or source_manifest.get("plan_sha256") != plan_sha256
            or source_manifest.get("inventory_sha256") != inventory_sha256):
        _fail("source manifest differs from the exact reviewed identity")
    compiler_sha = source_manifest.get("compiler_sha256")
    if (not isinstance(compiler_sha, str) or not HEX64.fullmatch(compiler_sha)
            or source_manifest.get("compiler_path") != "/usr/bin/cc"
            or source_manifest.get("compiler_symlink_target") != "/etc/alternatives/cc"
            or not isinstance(source_manifest.get("compiler_resolved_path"), str)
            or not re.fullmatch(r"/usr/bin/[A-Za-z0-9._+-]+",
                                source_manifest["compiler_resolved_path"])):
        _fail("source manifest compiler digest is malformed")
    expected = _expected_runtime(source_manifest.get("archive_members"))
    root_info = os.lstat(stage)
    if (not stat.S_ISDIR(root_info.st_mode) or root_info.st_uid != 0 or root_info.st_gid != 0
            or stat.S_IMODE(root_info.st_mode) != 0o755):
        _fail("staged runtime root must be root:root mode 0755")
    actual: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for current, directories, files in os.walk(stage, topdown=True, followlinks=False):
        directories.sort()
        files.sort()
        for name in directories + files:
            path = os.path.join(current, name)
            relative = os.path.relpath(path, stage).replace(os.sep, "/")
            if relative == MANIFEST:
                continue
            info = os.lstat(path)
            if stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode):
                if (info.st_uid != 0 or info.st_gid != 0
                        or stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) != 0o755):
                    _fail("staged directory owner or mode is invalid: " + relative)
                actual[relative] = {"kind": "dir"}
            elif stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode):
                if (info.st_uid != 0 or info.st_gid != 0
                        or stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) != 0o644 or info.st_nlink != 1):
                    _fail("staged file owner, mode, or link count is invalid: " + relative)
                digest, size = _hash_file(path, info)
                actual[relative] = {"kind": "file", "sha256": digest, "size": size}
            else:
                _fail("staged tree contains a symlink or special object: " + relative)
    if actual != expected:
        missing = sorted(expected.keys() - actual.keys())
        extra = sorted(actual.keys() - expected.keys())
        changed = sorted(name for name in expected.keys() & actual.keys()
                         if expected[name] != actual[name])
        _fail("tree differs from source map (missing=%r extra=%r changed=%r)" %
              (missing[:5], extra[:5], changed[:5]))
    if sorted(os.listdir(stage)) != [MANIFEST, "docs", "tools"]:
        _fail("staged top-level entries differ from the fixed layout")
    marker_path = stage / MANIFEST
    marker_info = os.lstat(marker_path)
    if (not stat.S_ISREG(marker_info.st_mode) or marker_info.st_uid != 0
            or marker_info.st_gid != 0 or stat.S_IMODE(marker_info.st_mode) != 0o644
            or marker_info.st_nlink != 1 or marker_info.st_size > 4096):
        _fail("runtime marker metadata is invalid")
    marker = _read_root_json(marker_path, mode=0o644, maximum=4096)
    expected_marker = {
        "archive_sha256": archive_sha256,
        "compiler_path": source_manifest.get("compiler_path"),
        "compiler_resolved_path": source_manifest.get("compiler_resolved_path"),
        "compiler_sha256": compiler_sha,
        "compiler_symlink_target": source_manifest.get("compiler_symlink_target"),
        "head": expected_head, "inventory_sha256": inventory_sha256,
        "plan_sha256": plan_sha256, "schema": 3,
    }
    if marker != expected_marker:
        _fail("runtime marker differs from source and target provenance")
    return marker


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--stage", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--source-manifest", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-head", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--archive-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--plan-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--inventory-sha256", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    verify_staged_runtime(Path(args.stage), Path(args.source_manifest),
                          expected_head=args.expected_head,
                          archive_sha256=args.archive_sha256,
                          plan_sha256=args.plan_sha256,
                          inventory_sha256=args.inventory_sha256)
    print("verified staged runtime against exact reviewed source map")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

===== BEGIN tools/qa/verify_wsl_source_bundle.py sha256=79eb0b1748d97d7c06eae84f49f0625edaec26a29205aaca252566589a83ca4b bytes=10387 =====
"""Fail-closed verification of the reviewed S2 runtime source bundle."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import stat
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

HEX40 = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{40}$")
HEX64 = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
MANIFEST_NAME = ".vst-source-manifest.json"
MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_ENTRIES = 50_000
ALLOWED_FILES = frozenset({
    "docs/SANDBOX_SPEC.md",
    "tools/qa/install_wsl_runner_runtime.sh",
    "tools/qa/install_wsl_worker_helper.sh",
    "tools/qa/verify_wsl_source_bundle.py",
    "tools/qa/verify_wsl_runtime_stage.py",
    "tools/qa/worker_exec.c",
})
UNITS = (
    "vst-supervisor.service", "vst-signer.service", "vst-runner.service",
    "vst-dispatcher.service", "vst-dispatch-owner.service", "vst-dispatch-owner.socket",
)


def _fail(message: str) -> None:
    raise SystemExit("source bundle verification failed: " + message)


def _pairs_no_duplicates(items: list[tuple[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    result: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for key, value in items:
        if key in result:
            _fail("manifest has duplicate JSON fields")
        result[key] = value
    return result


def _read_manifest(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    info = os.lstat(path)
    if (not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_uid != 0
            or info.st_gid != 0 or stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) != 0o600
            or info.st_nlink != 1 or info.st_size > MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES):
        _fail("manifest must be a bounded root-owned mode-0600 single-link regular file")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0))
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        if (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino) != (info.st_dev, info.st_ino):
            _fail("manifest changed while opening")
        raw = os.read(fd, MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES + 1)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    if len(raw) != info.st_size or len(raw) > MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES:
        _fail("manifest changed or exceeded its size limit while reading")
    try:
        value = json.loads(raw, object_pairs_hook=_pairs_no_duplicates,
                           parse_constant=lambda _value: _fail("manifest contains a non-finite value"))
    except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        raise SystemExit("source bundle verification failed: manifest is not valid UTF-8 JSON") from exc
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        _fail("manifest must be an object")
    return value


def _valid_relative_path(name: object) -> bool:
    return (isinstance(name, str) and bool(name) and not name.startswith("/")
            and "\\" not in name
            and all(part not in ("", ".", "..") for part in name.split("/")))


def _validate_members(value: object) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or not 0 < len(value) <= MAX_ENTRIES:
        _fail("archive member map is missing, empty, or too large")
    result: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for name, entry in value.items():
        if not _valid_relative_path(name) or name == MANIFEST_NAME:
            _fail("archive member path is not canonical")
        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
            _fail("archive member record must be an object")
        if entry == {"kind": "dir"}:
            if not (name in {"tools", "tools/vst", "tools/qa", "docs"}
                    or name.startswith("tools/vst/")):
                _fail("archive directory is outside the fixed source allowlist")
            result[name] = entry
            continue
        if set(entry) != {"kind", "sha256", "size"} or entry.get("kind") != "file":
            _fail("archive member has an unsupported type or field set")
        if not isinstance(entry.get("sha256"), str) or not HEX64.fullmatch(entry["sha256"]):
            _fail("archive member digest is invalid")
        if type(entry.get("size")) is not int or entry["size"] < 0:
            _fail("archive member size is invalid")
        if not (name in ALLOWED_FILES or name.startswith("tools/vst/")):
            _fail("archive file is outside the fixed source allowlist")
        result[name] = entry
    required = set(ALLOWED_FILES) | {
        "tools/vst/runner.py", "tools/vst/signer.py", "tools/vst/store.py",
        "tools/vst/supervisor.py", "tools/vst/runner_service.py",
        "tools/vst/supervisor_service.py", "tools/vst/execution_grant.py",
        "tools/vst/runner_fence.py", "tools/vst/dispatcher_service.py",
        "tools/vst/dispatch_instruction.py", "tools/vst/dispatch_owner_client.py",
        "tools/vst/dispatch_owner_service.py", "tools/vst/dispatch_owner_latch.py",
    }
    required.update("tools/vst/systemd/" + unit for unit in UNITS)
    file_names = {name for name, entry in result.items() if entry["kind"] == "file"}
    if not required <= file_names:
        _fail("reviewed source plan is missing a required runtime artifact")
    return result


def _hash_regular_file(path: str, before: os.stat_result) -> tuple[str, int]:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0))
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        if (not stat.S_ISREG(opened.st_mode) or opened.st_nlink != 1
                or (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino) != (before.st_dev, before.st_ino)):
            _fail("source file changed type or identity while opening")
        digest = hashlib.sha256()
        size = 0
        while True:
            chunk = os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            size += len(chunk)
            digest.update(chunk)
        after = os.fstat(fd)
        if ((after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns)
                != (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size, opened.st_mtime_ns)):
            _fail("source file changed while hashing")
        return digest.hexdigest(), size
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def _scan_bundle(root: Path) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    result: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}

    def onerror(error: OSError) -> None:
        raise error

    for current, directories, files in os.walk(root, topdown=True, followlinks=False, onerror=onerror):
        directories.sort()
        files.sort()
        for name in directories + files:
            path = os.path.join(current, name)
            relative = os.path.relpath(path, root).replace(os.sep, "/")
            if relative == MANIFEST_NAME:
                continue
            info = os.lstat(path)
            if stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode):
                result[relative] = {"kind": "dir"}
            elif stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode):
                digest, size = _hash_regular_file(path, info)
                result[relative] = {"kind": "file", "sha256": digest, "size": size}
            else:
                _fail("source tree contains a symlink or special object: " + relative)
            if len(result) > MAX_ENTRIES:
                _fail("source tree has too many entries")
    return result


def verify_source_bundle(root: Path, *, expected_head: str,
                         expected_archive_sha256: str,
                         expected_plan_sha256: str,
                         expected_inventory_sha256: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    root = Path(root)
    try:
        info = os.lstat(root)
    except OSError as exc:
        raise SystemExit("source bundle verification failed: bundle root is unavailable") from exc
    if not stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) or info.st_uid != 0 or stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) != 0o700:
        _fail("bundle root must be a root-owned mode-0700 directory")
    root = root.resolve(strict=True)
    if not HEX40.fullmatch(expected_head):
        _fail("expected source revision is invalid")
    if (not HEX64.fullmatch(expected_archive_sha256)
            or not HEX64.fullmatch(expected_plan_sha256)
            or not HEX64.fullmatch(expected_inventory_sha256)):
        _fail("expected source digest is invalid")
    manifest = _read_manifest(root / MANIFEST_NAME)
    if set(manifest) != {"archive_members", "archive_sha256", "compiler_path",
                         "compiler_resolved_path", "compiler_sha256", "compiler_symlink_target",
                         "head", "inventory_sha256", "plan_sha256", "schema"}:
        _fail("manifest field set differs from reviewed schema")
    if (manifest["schema"] != 3 or manifest["head"] != expected_head
            or manifest["archive_sha256"] != expected_archive_sha256
            or manifest["plan_sha256"] != expected_plan_sha256
            or manifest["inventory_sha256"] != expected_inventory_sha256
            or manifest["compiler_path"] != "/usr/bin/cc"
            or manifest["compiler_symlink_target"] != "/etc/alternatives/cc"
            or not isinstance(manifest["compiler_resolved_path"], str)
            or not re.fullmatch(r"/usr/bin/[A-Za-z0-9._+-]+", manifest["compiler_resolved_path"])
            or not isinstance(manifest["compiler_sha256"], str)
            or not HEX64.fullmatch(manifest["compiler_sha256"])):
        _fail("manifest identity does not match the reviewed source plan")
    expected = _validate_members(manifest["archive_members"])
    actual = _scan_bundle(root)
    if actual != expected:
        missing = sorted(expected.keys() - actual.keys())
        extra = sorted(actual.keys() - expected.keys())
        changed = sorted(name for name in expected.keys() & actual.keys()
                         if expected[name] != actual[name])
        _fail("archive member map differs (missing=%r extra=%r changed=%r)" %
              (missing[:5], extra[:5], changed[:5]))
    return manifest


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--root", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-head", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--archive-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--plan-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--inventory-sha256", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    verify_source_bundle(Path(args.root), expected_head=args.expected_head,
                         expected_archive_sha256=args.archive_sha256,
                         expected_plan_sha256=args.plan_sha256,
                         expected_inventory_sha256=args.inventory_sha256)
    print("verified exact reviewed source bundle")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

/*
 * Fixed WSL test helper: vst-runner (997:988) -> vst-worker (999:989).
 * It does not accept a UID, GID, executable path, environment or shell command.
 */
#define _GNU_SOURCE

#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <grp.h>
#include <limits.h>
#include <linux/capability.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/prctl.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/syscall.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#ifndef HELPER_BUILD_HEAD
#error "helper build must bind a committed source HEAD"
#endif
#ifndef HELPER_SOURCE_SHA256
#error "helper build must bind the source digest"
#endif

extern char **environ;

enum {
    RUNNER_UID = 997,
    RUNNER_GID = 988,
    WORKER_UID = 999,
    WORKER_GID = 989,
    MAX_ARGUMENTS = 64,
    MAX_ARGUMENT_BYTES = 131072,
};

static const char PYTHON[] = "/usr/bin/python3.12";

static int refuse(const char *message) {
    (void)dprintf(STDERR_FILENO, "vst-s4-worker-exec: %s\n", message);
    return 126;
}

static int valid_invocation(int argc, char *const argv[]) {
    size_t total = 0;
    char *end = NULL;
    long env_fd;
    long gate_fd;

    if (argc < 7 || argc > MAX_ARGUMENTS || strcmp(argv[1], "-I") != 0 ||
        strcmp(argv[2], "-c") != 0 || argv[3][0] == '\0') {
        return 0;
    }
    errno = 0;
    env_fd = strtol(argv[4], &end, 10);
    if (errno != 0 || end == argv[4] || *end != '\0' || env_fd < 3 || env_fd > INT_MAX) {
        return 0;
    }
    errno = 0;
    gate_fd = strtol(argv[5], &end, 10);
    if (errno != 0 || end == argv[5] || *end != '\0' || gate_fd < 3 || gate_fd > INT_MAX ||
        gate_fd == env_fd) {
        return 0;
    }
    for (int index = 1; index < argc; ++index) {
        size_t length = strnlen(argv[index], MAX_ARGUMENT_BYTES + 1U);
        if (length >= MAX_ARGUMENT_BYTES || total > MAX_ARGUMENT_BYTES - length - 1U) {
            return 0;
        }
        total += length + 1U;
    }
    return 1;
}

static int clear_capability_sets(void) {
    struct __user_cap_header_struct header = {
        .version = _LINUX_CAPABILITY_VERSION_3,
        .pid = 0,
    };
    struct __user_cap_data_struct capabilities[_LINUX_CAPABILITY_U32S_3] = {{0}};

    if (prctl(PR_CAP_AMBIENT, PR_CAP_AMBIENT_CLEAR_ALL, 0, 0, 0) != 0 ||
        syscall(SYS_capset, &header, capabilities) != 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    memset(capabilities, 0, sizeof(capabilities));
    if (syscall(SYS_capget, &header, capabilities) != 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    for (size_t index = 0; index < (size_t)_LINUX_CAPABILITY_U32S_3; ++index) {
        if (capabilities[index].effective != 0 ||
            capabilities[index].permitted != 0 ||
            capabilities[index].inheritable != 0) {
            return 0;
        }
    }
    return 1;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    uid_t real_uid = (uid_t)-1;
    uid_t effective_uid = (uid_t)-1;
    uid_t saved_uid = (uid_t)-1;
    gid_t real_gid = (gid_t)-1;
    gid_t effective_gid = (gid_t)-1;
    gid_t saved_gid = (gid_t)-1;
    gid_t supplementary[1];
    int supplementary_count;
    char **child_argv;
    int env_source;
    int gate_source;
    int env_copy;
    int gate_copy;
    struct stat env_stat;
    struct stat gate_stat;

    if (argc == 2 && strcmp(argv[1], "--version") == 0) {
        (void)printf("schema=1 head=%s source_sha256=%s\n",
                     HELPER_BUILD_HEAD, HELPER_SOURCE_SHA256);
        return 0;
    }
    if (!valid_invocation(argc, argv)) {
        return refuse("usage is fixed: vst-s4-worker-exec -I -c SCRIPT ENV_FD GATE_FD ARG...");
    }
    env_source = (int)strtol(argv[4], NULL, 10);
    gate_source = (int)strtol(argv[5], NULL, 10);
    if (fstat(env_source, &env_stat) != 0 || fstat(gate_source, &gate_stat) != 0 ||
        !S_ISFIFO(env_stat.st_mode) || !S_ISFIFO(gate_stat.st_mode) ||
        env_stat.st_ino == gate_stat.st_ino) {
        return refuse("environment and release descriptors must be distinct pipes");
    }
    if (getresuid(&real_uid, &effective_uid, &saved_uid) != 0 ||
        getresgid(&real_gid, &effective_gid, &saved_gid) != 0 ||
        real_uid != RUNNER_UID || real_gid != RUNNER_GID ||
        effective_uid != 0 || saved_uid != 0 ||
        effective_gid != RUNNER_GID || saved_gid != RUNNER_GID) {
        return refuse("caller identity or installed setuid state does not match 997:988");
    }

    if (setgroups(0, NULL) != 0 ||
        setresgid(WORKER_GID, WORKER_GID, WORKER_GID) != 0 ||
        setresuid(WORKER_UID, WORKER_UID, WORKER_UID) != 0 ||
        !clear_capability_sets() ||
        prctl(PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS, 1, 0, 0, 0) != 0) {
        return refuse("could not irreversibly drop to the fixed worker identity and capabilities");
    }
    supplementary_count = getgroups(1, supplementary);
    if (getresuid(&real_uid, &effective_uid, &saved_uid) != 0 ||
        getresgid(&real_gid, &effective_gid, &saved_gid) != 0 ||
        real_uid != WORKER_UID ||
        effective_uid != WORKER_UID || saved_uid != WORKER_UID ||
        real_gid != WORKER_GID || effective_gid != WORKER_GID ||
        saved_gid != WORKER_GID || supplementary_count != 0) {
        return refuse("post-drop identity verification failed");
    }
    env_copy = fcntl(env_source, F_DUPFD_CLOEXEC, 5);
    gate_copy = fcntl(gate_source, F_DUPFD_CLOEXEC, 5);
    if (env_copy < 0 || gate_copy < 0 || dup2(env_copy, 3) < 0 || dup2(gate_copy, 4) < 0 ||
        close_range(5U, UINT_MAX, 0U) != 0) {
        return refuse("could not close inherited file descriptors");
    }

    if (clearenv() != 0 || setenv("PATH", "/usr/bin:/bin", 1) != 0 ||
        setenv("HOME", "/nonexistent", 1) != 0 ||
        setenv("LANG", "C.UTF-8", 1) != 0 ||
        setenv("LC_ALL", "C.UTF-8", 1) != 0 ||
        setenv("PYTHONNOUSERSITE", "1", 1) != 0 ||
        setenv("PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE", "1", 1) != 0 ||
        setenv("TMPDIR", "/tmp", 1) != 0) {
        return refuse("could not create the fixed child environment");
    }
    (void)umask(0077);

    child_argv = calloc((size_t)argc + 1U, sizeof(*child_argv));
    if (child_argv == NULL) {
        return refuse("could not allocate child arguments");
    }
    child_argv[0] = (char *)PYTHON;
    child_argv[1] = argv[1];
    child_argv[2] = argv[2];
    child_argv[3] = argv[3];
    child_argv[4] = "3";
    child_argv[5] = "4";
    for (int index = 6; index < argc; ++index) {
        child_argv[index] = argv[index];
    }
    child_argv[argc] = NULL;
    execve(PYTHON, child_argv, environ);
    (void)dprintf(STDERR_FILENO, "vst-s4-worker-exec: execve failed: %s\n", strerror(errno));
    free(child_argv);
    return 127;
}

This module deliberately contains no signing, persistence, or assignment writer.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import posixpath

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any

from .contracts import ContractError, canonical_bytes, manifest_sha256, validate_task_manifest

def _object(value: Any, fields: set[str], name: str) -> dict:
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != fields:
        raise ContractError(f"{name} fields do not match the closed schema")
    return value


def _text(value: Any, name: str, *, pattern: re.Pattern[str] | None = None) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value or value.strip() != value:
        raise ContractError(f"{name} must be a non-empty canonical string")
    if pattern is not None and pattern.fullmatch(value) is None:
        raise ContractError(f"{name} has an invalid format")
    return value


def _integer(value: Any, name: str, minimum: int, maximum: int | None = None) -> int:
    if type(value) is not int or value < minimum or (maximum is not None and value > maximum):
        raise ContractError(f"{name} is outside its integer bounds")
    return value


def _utc(value: Any, name: str) -> datetime:
    text = _text(value, name)
    try:
        parsed = datetime.strptime(text, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ").replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise ContractError(f"{name} must be canonical UTC") from exc
    if parsed.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") != text:
        raise ContractError(f"{name} must be canonical UTC")
    return parsed


def _peer(value: Any, role: str) -> dict:
    peer = _object(value, _PEER_FIELDS, f"{role} peer")
    if peer["role"] != role:
        raise ContractError(f"peer role must be {role}")
    _integer(peer["uid"], f"{role}.uid", 1)
    _integer(peer["gid"], f"{role}.gid", 1)
    _text(peer["cgroup"], f"{role}.cgroup")
    if (not peer["cgroup"].startswith("/") or ".." in peer["cgroup"].split("/")
            or posixpath.normpath(peer["cgroup"]) != peer["cgroup"]):
        raise ContractError(f"{role}.cgroup is not an absolute normalized path")
    return copy.deepcopy(peer)


def validate_policy(value: Any) -> tuple[dict, str]:
    policy = _object(value, _POLICY_FIELDS, "assignment policy")
    if policy["schema"] != POLICY_SCHEMA or policy["owner_principal"] != "Codex":
        raise ContractError("assignment policy schema or owner principal is invalid")
    _text(policy["policy_id"], "policy_id", pattern=_ID)
    if policy["repository"] != "Virtual_scrum_team":
        raise ContractError("assignment policy repository is not fixed")
    _text(policy["sprint_id"], "sprint_id", pattern=_ID)
    _text(policy["source_head"], "source_head", pattern=_HEAD)
    _text(policy["manifest_sha256"], "manifest_sha256", pattern=_SHA)
    _text(policy["revocation_id"], "revocation_id", pattern=_ID)
    _text(policy["runner_id"], "runner_id", pattern=_ID)
    for field in ("owner_ttl_seconds", "lease_ttl_seconds"):
        ttl = policy[field]
        if type(ttl) is not int or ttl < 1 or ttl > MAX_ASSIGNMENT_TTL_SECONDS:
            raise ContractError(f"{field} must be an integer in [1, {MAX_ASSIGNMENT_TTL_SECONDS}]")
    if policy["lease_ttl_seconds"] > policy["owner_ttl_seconds"]:
        raise ContractError("lease_ttl_seconds cannot exceed owner_ttl_seconds")
    assignments = policy["allowed_assignments"]
    if not isinstance(assignments, list) or not assignments:
        raise ContractError("assignment policy must contain a non-empty assignment allowlist")
    seen: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
    seen_story_ids: set[str] = set()
    seen_task_ids: set[str] = set()
    for entry in assignments:
        entry = _object(entry, _ASSIGNMENT_FIELDS, "allowed assignment")
        story = _text(entry["story_id"], "story_id", pattern=_ID)
        task = _text(entry["task_id"], "task_id", pattern=_ID)
        _text(entry["project_id"], "project_id", pattern=_ID)
        _integer(entry["phase"], "phase", 1, 10)
        _text(entry["task_manifest_sha256"], "task_manifest_sha256", pattern=_SHA)
        key = (story, task)
        if key in seen:
            raise ContractError("assignment policy contains a duplicate story/task pair")
        if story in seen_story_ids or task in seen_task_ids:
            raise ContractError("assignment policy reuses a story or task identifier")
        seen.add(key)
        seen_story_ids.add(story)
        seen_task_ids.add(task)
        slots = entry["test_run_slots"]
        if (not isinstance(slots, list) or not slots or any(
                not isinstance(slot, str) or not _ID.fullmatch(slot) for slot in slots)
                or len(slots) != len(set(slots))):
            raise ContractError("assignment slots must be unique non-empty TestRun slot names")
    bootstrap = _peer(policy["bootstrap_peer"], "assignment_bootstrap")
    issuer = _peer(policy["issuer_peer"], "delegated_issuer")
    if (bootstrap["uid"] == issuer["uid"] or bootstrap["gid"] == issuer["gid"]
            or bootstrap["cgroup"] == issuer["cgroup"]):
        raise ContractError("assignment peers must have distinct process identities")
    expected_ops = ["open_story", "register_task", "acquire_epoch", "acquire_lease"]
    if policy["allowed_bootstrap_operations"] != expected_ops:
        raise ContractError("assignment bootstrap operation set is not fixed")
    _integer(policy["maximum_handoff_ttl_seconds"], "maximum_handoff_ttl_seconds", 1, 300)
    valid_from = _utc(policy["valid_from_utc"], "valid_from_utc")
    expires = _utc(policy["expires_at_utc"], "expires_at_utc")
    if expires <= valid_from:
        raise ContractError("assignment policy expiry must follow validity start")
    digest = hashlib.sha256(canonical_bytes(policy)).hexdigest()
    return copy.deepcopy(policy), digest


def validate_request(value: Any) -> str:
    request = _object(value, _REQUEST_FIELDS, "assignment-basis request")
    if request["schema"] != REQUEST_SCHEMA:
        raise ContractError("assignment-basis request schema is invalid")
    return _text(request["assignment_operation_id"], "assignment_operation_id", pattern=_SHA)


def validate_bootstrap_request(value: Any, *, policy: dict) -> dict:
    request = _object(value, _BOOTSTRAP_REQUEST_FIELDS, "authenticated bootstrap request")
    if request["schema"] != "VST_S2_ASSIGNMENT_BOOTSTRAP_REQUEST_V1":
        raise ContractError("authenticated bootstrap request schema is invalid")
    _text(request["request_id"], "request_id", pattern=_REQUEST_ID)
    story_id = _text(request["story_id"], "story_id", pattern=_ID)
    task_id = _text(request["task_id"], "task_id", pattern=_ID)
    slot = _text(request["slot"], "slot", pattern=_ID)
    _integer(request["attempt"], "attempt", 1)
    if request["attempt"] != 1:
        raise ContractError("fresh assignment bootstrap only permits attempt 1")
    run_id = _text(request["run_id"], "run_id", pattern=_ID)
    manifest = validate_task_manifest(request["task_manifest"])
    if (manifest["task_id"] != task_id or manifest["story_id"] != story_id
            or manifest_sha256(manifest) != manifest_sha256(request["task_manifest"])):
        raise ContractError("bootstrap request task manifest identity or canonical digest is invalid")
    allowed = [entry for entry in policy["allowed_assignments"]
               if entry["task_id"] == task_id and entry["story_id"] == story_id]
    if len(allowed) != 1 or allowed[0]["task_manifest_sha256"] != manifest_sha256(manifest):
        raise ContractError("bootstrap request task is outside the root assignment allowlist")
    if manifest["project_id"] != allowed[0]["project_id"] or manifest["phase"] != allowed[0]["phase"]:
        raise ContractError("bootstrap request project or phase differs from root assignment")
    test_run_slots = {
        entry["slot"] for entry in manifest["required_receipts"]
        if entry["receipt_type"] == "TestRun"
    }
    if slot not in test_run_slots or slot not in allowed[0]["test_run_slots"]:
        raise ContractError("bootstrap request slot is outside the root TestRun assignment allowlist")
    return {
        "schema": request["schema"], "request_id": request["request_id"],
        "story_id": story_id, "task_id": task_id, "task_manifest": manifest,
        "slot": slot, "attempt": request["attempt"], "run_id": run_id,
    }


def assignment_operation_id(request: dict, *, policy_sha256: str) -> str:
    identity = {
        "policy_sha256": policy_sha256, "task_id": request["task_id"],
        "story_id": request["story_id"],
        "task_manifest_sha256": manifest_sha256(request["task_manifest"]),
        "request_id": request["request_id"],
    }
    domain = b"VST_S2_AUTHENTICATED_ASSIGNMENT_V1\0"
    return hashlib.sha256(domain + canonical_bytes(identity)).hexdigest()


def assignment_payload_sha256(request: dict, *, policy: dict, policy_sha256: str) -> str:
    payload = {
        "request": request, "bootstrap_peer": policy["bootstrap_peer"],
        "policy_sha256": policy_sha256,
    }
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical_bytes(payload)).hexdigest()


def validate_handoff(value: Any, *, policy: dict, policy_sha256: str, now: datetime) -> dict:
    handoff = _object(value, _HANDOFF_FIELDS, "assignment handoff")
    if handoff["schema"] != HANDOFF_SCHEMA:
        raise ContractError("assignment handoff schema is invalid")
    for field in ("assignment_operation_id", "policy_sha256", "manifest_sha256",
                  "task_manifest_sha256", "probe_sha256", "handoff_sha256"):
        _text(handoff[field], field, pattern=_SHA)
    if handoff["policy_sha256"] != policy_sha256:
        raise ContractError("assignment handoff policy digest differs from root policy")
    fixed = ("policy_id", "repository", "sprint_id", "source_head", "manifest_sha256")
    if any(handoff[field] != policy[field] for field in fixed):
        raise ContractError("assignment handoff differs from root policy identity")
    if handoff["assignment_principal"] != policy["owner_principal"]:
        raise ContractError("assignment handoff principal differs from root policy")
    bootstrap = _peer(handoff["bootstrap_peer"], "assignment_bootstrap")
    if bootstrap != policy["bootstrap_peer"]:
        raise ContractError("assignment handoff bootstrap peer differs from root policy")
    bootstrap_request = validate_bootstrap_request(handoff["bootstrap_request"], policy=policy)
    _text(handoff["task_id"], "task_id", pattern=_ID)
    _text(handoff["story_id"], "story_id", pattern=_ID)
    _text(handoff["project_id"], "project_id", pattern=_ID)
    _integer(handoff["phase"], "phase", 1, 10)
    _text(handoff["slot"], "slot", pattern=_ID)
    _text(handoff["runner_id"], "runner_id", pattern=_ID)
    _text(handoff["run_id"], "run_id", pattern=_ID)
    _text(handoff["service_generation"], "service_generation", pattern=_ID)
    _integer(handoff["attempt"], "attempt", 1)
    _integer(handoff["epoch"], "epoch", 1)
    _integer(handoff["lease_id"], "lease_id", 1)
    if (bootstrap_request["task_id"] != handoff["task_id"]
            or bootstrap_request["story_id"] != handoff["story_id"]
            or bootstrap_request["task_manifest"]["project_id"] != handoff["project_id"]
            or bootstrap_request["task_manifest"]["phase"] != handoff["phase"]
            or handoff["runner_id"] != policy["runner_id"]
            or manifest_sha256(bootstrap_request["task_manifest"]) != handoff["task_manifest_sha256"]
            or bootstrap_request["slot"] != handoff["slot"]
            or bootstrap_request["attempt"] != handoff["attempt"]
            or bootstrap_request["run_id"] != handoff["run_id"]
            or assignment_operation_id(bootstrap_request, policy_sha256=policy_sha256)
            != handoff["assignment_operation_id"]):
        raise ContractError("assignment handoff differs from its canonical bootstrap request identity")
    allowed = [entry for entry in policy["allowed_assignments"]
               if entry["task_id"] == handoff["task_id"] and entry["story_id"] == handoff["story_id"]]
    if (len(allowed) != 1 or allowed[0]["task_manifest_sha256"] != handoff["task_manifest_sha256"]
            or allowed[0]["project_id"] != handoff["project_id"]
            or allowed[0]["phase"] != handoff["phase"]):
        raise ContractError("assignment handoff is outside the root assignment allowlist")
    if handoff["slot"] not in allowed[0]["test_run_slots"]:
        raise ContractError("assignment handoff slot is outside the root assignment allowlist")
    issued = _utc(handoff["issued_at_utc"], "issued_at_utc")
    expires = _utc(handoff["expires_at_utc"], "expires_at_utc")
    if (expires <= issued or issued > now or expires <= now
            or (expires - issued).total_seconds() > policy["maximum_handoff_ttl_seconds"]
            or issued < _utc(policy["valid_from_utc"], "valid_from_utc")
            or expires > _utc(policy["expires_at_utc"], "expires_at_utc")):
        raise ContractError("assignment handoff is expired or outside policy validity")
    body = {key: item for key, item in handoff.items() if key != "handoff_sha256"}
    if hashlib.sha256(canonical_bytes(body)).hexdigest() != handoff["handoff_sha256"]:
        raise ContractError("assignment handoff digest is invalid")
    return {
        **copy.deepcopy(handoff),
        "bootstrap_request": bootstrap_request,
        "payload_sha256": assignment_payload_sha256(
            bootstrap_request, policy=policy, policy_sha256=policy_sha256,
        ),
    }


def build_response(handoff: dict, *, policy: dict, policy_sha256: str, authority_expires_at: float,
                   service_generation: str) -> dict:
    expires = datetime.fromtimestamp(authority_expires_at, timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0)
    result = {
        "schema": RESPONSE_SCHEMA,
        "assignment_operation_id": handoff["assignment_operation_id"],
        "handoff_sha256": handoff["handoff_sha256"],
        "policy_id": policy["policy_id"], "policy_sha256": policy_sha256,
        "repository": policy["repository"], "sprint_id": policy["sprint_id"],
        "source_head": policy["source_head"], "manifest_sha256": policy["manifest_sha256"],
        "task_id": handoff["task_id"], "story_id": handoff["story_id"],
        "task_manifest_sha256": handoff["task_manifest_sha256"], "slot": handoff["slot"],
        "attempt": handoff["attempt"], "epoch": handoff["epoch"], "lease_id": handoff["lease_id"],
        "runner_id": handoff["runner_id"], "principal": policy["owner_principal"],
        "run_id": handoff["run_id"], "probe_sha256": handoff["probe_sha256"],
        "authority_expires_at_utc": expires.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
        "service_generation": _text(service_generation, "service_generation"),
    }
    _object(result, _RESPONSE_FIELDS, "assignment-basis response")
    if expires.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") > handoff["expires_at_utc"]:
        raise ContractError("assignment-basis response exceeds handoff expiry")
    return validate_response(result, policy=policy, policy_sha256=policy_sha256, handoff=handoff)


def validate_response(value: Any, *, policy: dict, policy_sha256: str, handoff: dict) -> dict:
    response = _object(value, _RESPONSE_FIELDS, "assignment-basis response")
    if response["schema"] != RESPONSE_SCHEMA:
        raise ContractError("assignment-basis response schema is invalid")
    for field in ("assignment_operation_id", "handoff_sha256", "policy_sha256",
                  "manifest_sha256", "task_manifest_sha256", "probe_sha256"):
        _text(response[field], field, pattern=_SHA)
    expected = {
        "assignment_operation_id": handoff["assignment_operation_id"],
        "handoff_sha256": handoff["handoff_sha256"], "policy_id": policy["policy_id"],
        "policy_sha256": policy_sha256, "repository": policy["repository"],
        "sprint_id": policy["sprint_id"], "source_head": policy["source_head"],
        "manifest_sha256": policy["manifest_sha256"], "task_id": handoff["task_id"],
        "story_id": handoff["story_id"], "task_manifest_sha256": handoff["task_manifest_sha256"],
        "slot": handoff["slot"], "attempt": handoff["attempt"], "epoch": handoff["epoch"],
        "lease_id": handoff["lease_id"], "runner_id": handoff["runner_id"],
        "principal": policy["owner_principal"], "run_id": handoff["run_id"],
        "probe_sha256": handoff["probe_sha256"],
    }
    if any(response[key] != item for key, item in expected.items()):
        raise ContractError("assignment-basis response differs from its verified inputs")
    for field in ("task_id", "story_id", "slot", "runner_id", "principal", "run_id",
                  "service_generation"):
        _text(response[field], field, pattern=_ID if field != "principal" else None)
    for field in ("attempt", "epoch", "lease_id"):
        _integer(response[field], field, 1)
    authority_expiry = _utc(response["authority_expires_at_utc"], "authority_expires_at_utc")
    if authority_expiry > _utc(handoff["expires_at_utc"], "expires_at_utc"):
        raise ContractError("assignment-basis response exceeds handoff expiry")
    return copy.deepcopy(response)
